premise: Beaver wants a band: Woodpecker drums on a trunk, Pinecone rattles her scales, Bee hums, Frog croaks — all at different speeds — and Beaver's slow scritch-scratch gnawing turns out to be the rhythm that holds them together.
inspiration: The Bremen Town Musicians (Grimm), turned: nobody has to travel to be a band, and the odd one out keeps the time.
lesson: The quiet one can be the one everyone needs.

en-US.title: The Meadow Band
en-US.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Beaver wanted a band. A real meadow band! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} Who can play? he called. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker landed on a tree trunk. I can drum! {woodpecker:live} {sfx:drum} Rat-a-tat-TAT! {pinecone:enter} Pinecone came rolling up. I can shake! {pinecone:live} Shh-shh went her scales. {bee:enter} Bee came buzzing over the meadow. I can hum! {bee:live} Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog called out from the pond: CROAK! [curious] And what do you play, Beaver? {beaver:face sad} Beaver looked at his stick. I just gnaw, he said. So they played. Rat-a-tat! Shh-shh! Mmm! CROAK! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} All at once, and all at different speeds. [laughs] What a jumble! Beaver sat down with a sigh and {beaver:live} {sfx:gnaw} gnawed. Scritch, scratch. Scritch, scratch. Slow and steady. {woodpecker:pulse} Woodpecker drummed along. {pinecone:pulse} Pinecone shook along. {frog:hop} Frog croaked along, and Bee hummed along. {all:face happy} [excited] It was music! {canvas:confetti 0.7 6s} {all:hop x2} Hooray for the band! [happily] And its name? The Scritch-Scratch Band, of course.

es-ES.title: La banda del prado
es-ES.text: [excited] {beaver:enter} Castor quería una banda. ¡Una banda del prado de verdad! {beaver:face happy} {beaver:hop} ¿Quién sabe tocar? preguntó. {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se posó en un tronco. ¡Yo toco el tambor! {woodpecker:live} {sfx:drum} ¡Ra-ta-ta-TÁ! {pinecone:enter} Piña llegó rodando. ¡Yo hago de maraca! {pinecone:live} Chis-chas, sonaron sus escamas. {bee:enter} Abeja llegó zumbando por el prado. ¡Yo tarareo! {bee:live} Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana cantó desde la charca: ¡CROAC! [curious] ¿Y tú qué tocas, Castor? {beaver:face sad} Castor miró su palo. Yo solo sé roer, dijo. Así que se pusieron a tocar. ¡Ra-ta-tá! ¡Chis-chas! ¡Mmm! ¡CROAC! {all:face surprised} {all:wobble} Todos a la vez, y cada uno a su ritmo. [laughs] ¡Menudo lío! Castor se sentó con un suspiro y {beaver:live} {sfx:gnaw} royó. Ric, rac. Ric, rac. Despacito y sin parar. {woodpecker:pulse} Carpintero tocó con él. {pinecone:pulse} Piña sonó con él. {frog:hop} Rana croó con él, y Abeja tarareó con él. {all:face happy} [excited] ¡Era música! {canvas:confetti 0.7 6s} {all:hop x2} ¡Viva la banda! [happily] ¿Y cómo se llama? La banda Ric-Rac, claro.
